name: Four Seasons Hotel des Bergues
positioning: Historic neo-classical hotel overlooking Lake Geneva, a landmark since 1834, with a Michelin-starred Italian restaurant and a rooftop spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Michelin-starred Italian restaurant at the hotel
Guests who want a rooftop spa with a pool and hammam

facts.text: The hotel has 115 rooms in total.
The hotel's address is 33, Quai des Bergues, 1201 Geneva, Switzerland.
The hotel is described as a landmark Lake Geneva hotel since 1834.
The hotel is housed in a historic neo-classical building.
The hotel is located steps from Rue du Rhône, the city's most upscale shopping street.
The hotel is a 10 minutes walk from the train station.
Il Lago is the hotel's Michelin-starred Italian restaurant.
Le Bar des Bergues offers an all-day menu of imaginative light fare plus innovative cocktails.
Pierre-Yves Rochon is the hotel's interior designer.
Salle des Nations was the site of the first assembly of the League of Nations in 1920.

highlights.text: The hotel has a rooftop Spa.
The spa has a lap pool and a separate vitality pool with a view of Geneva and the Salève.
The spa has an authentic Moroccan hammam.
The Royal Suite has tall windows overlooking Lake Geneva.
Suite Mont Blanc offers views of Lake Geneva's celebrated Jet d'Eau.
The hotel's wine cellar is home to nearly 15,000 bottles.

considerations.text: Geneva airport is 4.5 km from the hotel.
The Hammam, Steam Room and Pool have set children's hours.
The Spa hair salon is open Tuesday to Saturday, with Sunday and Monday on request and upon availability.
WhataHotel notes an ultra-luxury price point.
